phase: BNR Household DSTI Level Publication Boundary Review
purpose: Establish the exact semantic boundary of the BNR DSTI level observations published in Bank Lending Survey reports, using only values explicitly stated in report text. This review does not digitise charts, manufacture a longitudinal series, select a household-consumption equation, or make BNR borrower DSTI equivalent to a macro household-sector DSR.
source_family: National Bank of Romania Bank Lending Survey

semantic_identity.new_business_measure: new housing loans granted in the quarter / last three months
not_equivalent_to: aggregate household debt service divided by aggregate household income
BNR BLS P0303/P1103 net percentages about changes in maximum DSTI lending terms

continuity_evidence.interpretation: BNR reports show a quarterly historical series, but visual continuity does not authorize chart digitisation or inference of unreported exact points.

machine_readable_boundary.reason: The retained legacy workbooks encode BLS response distributions/net percentages, including P0303/P1103 lending-term-change questions. They do not by themselves constitute the published bank-average DSTI level history.
machine_readable_boundary.next_gate: Identify and retain an official machine-readable table/workbook/range for the housing-loan DSTI level series, separately for new and outstanding loans, or preregister a publication-text-only candidate family with its shorter explicit-observation window before any estimation.

prohibited_shortcuts: Relabel housing-loan DSTI as a macro household-sector DSR.
Relabel P0303/P1103 BLS net percentages as DSTI levels.
Digitise chart points to manufacture a canonical history.
Mix new-loan and outstanding-loan DSTI into one synthetic series.
Generalise housing-loan DSTI to consumer credit or all household debt without an explicit source bridge.
Open household-consumption estimation merely because several quarterly DSTI levels are now textually observed.
